attempted_contrary_interfaces: First-tier diversity treated as independent lower-tier supply.
A complete document treated as operational capability.
A partial exposure or criterion input rejected for failing the whole receiver.
Capacity, stock or staff double-counted for routine and contingency use.
Buyer savings treated as joint fair gain.

positive_controls.argument: The shared arrival, timing and service semantics define the relevant load and end-to-end boundary for capacity analysis.
The next risk-retiring result, integration boundary and commitment deadline identify which constrained capacity and completion horizon matter.
Forecast demand ranges and explicit service commitments define the loading scenarios whose queues and recovery capacity should be examined.
Supplier lead times, authority and committed delivery classes specify the real system boundary and exceptions for queue-aware coordination.
The actual startup tasks, support roles and allowed response times identify which capacity and queues matter for the transition.
Recovery objectives and tested task/resource dependencies specify the reserve or preemption conditions needed in the loading policy.
Sustainment service levels, skills and retirement horizons define relevant work classes and demand that the capacity policy must evaluate.
Actual consequence, urgency and permissible expedited authority define priorities and protected response capacity for the loading policy.
